notes: Iter 17 — NEW APPROACH: constructive grower replaces WFC + extend. Algorithm: place STATION_N at origin, push its port to frontier, pop random port, try TEE/CURVE/STRAIGHT/RAMP that matches entry+Y, fall back through the chain. Loop-close via STRAIGHT/CURVE → TEE → CROSS upgrade. Stop when frontier empty. Connectivity guaranteed by construction.

Iter 16: extendWFCLayout missed the parallel-overpass tile decompositions in its layout-build loop (only had under-pass), so when WFC's second pass placed a PARALLEL_OVERPASS_RAMP, the layout kept it as a virtual tile and samplePath threw. Added the three parallel decomp branches.

Iter 15: fixed extendWFCLayout's stacked-cell pin logic — was misidentifying parallel overpasses as under-passes (rotations didn't match the variant), causing 9/10 second-roll solves to throw and fall back to first-roll only.
